# Setup

## Packages

Load the standard packages.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: load

library(tidyverse) 
library(haven) # not core tidyverse
library(gssr)
library(gssrdoc)
library(summarytools)
library(gtsummary) 
library(modelbased)

```

## Load your data

```{r}
#| label: gssdata

# Load GSS 2024
gss24 <- gss_get_yr(2024)

```

Make a df with only the (pretty) categorical and continuous variables
we'll analyze.

```{r}
#| label: my-data

# Categorical Variables
my_cat <- gss24 |>
  select(id, sex, marital) |>
  zap_missing() |>
  mutate(
    sex = as_factor(sex),
    marital = as_factor(marital)) |> 
  droplevels()

# Continuous Variables
my_con <- gss24 |>
  select(id, age, educ, hrs1, realrinc) |>
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(age),
    educ = as.numeric(educ),
    hrs1 = as.numeric(hrs1),
    realrinc = as.numeric(realrinc))

# Combine the two dataframes
my_data <- full_join(my_cat, my_con, by = c("id")) |> 
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(
    marital = recode(
      marital,
      "married"       = "Married",
      "never married" = "Never married",
      "widowed"       = "Div/Wid/Sep",
      "divorced"      = "Div/Wid/Sep",
      "separated"     = "Div/Wid/Sep"),
    marital = factor(
      marital,
      levels = c("Never married", "Div/Wid/Sep", "Married"))
  )

remove(my_con) # clean up the Environment
remove(my_cat)
```

# Predictions

**OLS Regression Predicting Annual Income**

```{r}
#| label: regress
#| echo: false

model <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ educ + hrs1 + sex + marital, data = my_data)

model |>
    tbl_regression(
    intercept = TRUE,
        show_single_row = sex,
    label = list(
      sex = "Women",
      marital = "Marital status (ref. = never married)")) |>
  remove_row_type(type = c("reference")) |>  
  modify_column_hide(conf.low) |>
  modify_column_unhide(
    column = std.error) |>
  remove_abbreviation() |>
  add_significance_stars() |>
  add_glance_table(
    include = c("r.squared", "nobs"))

```

## Typical-person predictions

Means:

```{r}
#| label: means

mean(my_data$educ)
mean(my_data$hrs1)

```

**Typical-person predictions** using `estimate_means()`

```{r}
#| label: typical

preds <- estimate_means(
  model,
  estimate = "typical")

preds
```

Visualize it!

```{r}
#| label: typical-ggplot

ggplot(
  preds,
  aes(x = marital, y = Mean, color = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             position = position_dodge(width = .4)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    width = .1,
    position = position_dodge(width = .4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Income for Typical People",
    subtitle = "Hours worked and education fixed at their means",
    x = "Marital Status",
    y = "Predicted Income",
    color = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Marginal Means

```{r}
#| label: typical-sex

marginal_means <- estimate_means(
  model,
  by = "sex",
  estimate = "typical")

marginal_means
```

## Average Adjusted Predictions (AAP)

```{r}
#| label: aap-sex

aap <- estimate_means(
  model,
  by = "sex",
  estimate = "population")

aap

```

## Group-Average Predictions

```{r}
#| label: group-average

group_avg <- estimate_means(
  model,
  by = "sex",
  estimate = "average") |>
  mutate(method = "Group-average prediction")

group_avg
```

# Interactions

## Categorical X Continuous

Without an interaction:

```{r}
#| label: mod01-1

model_01 <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ educ + marital + age + hrs1 + sex, data = my_data)

p_inc <- estimate_means(
  model_01,
  by = c("marital", "educ = c(12:20)"),
  estimate = "population")

p_inc
```

```{r}
#| label: mod01-2

p_inc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = educ, y = Mean, colour = marital, shape = marital)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Annual Income",
    subtitle = "by years of education and marital status",
    caption = "Adjusted for age, work hours, and gender") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

```

With an interaction:

```{r}
#| label: mod01-3a

model_02 <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ educ * marital
               + age + hrs1 + sex, data = my_data)
moderndive::get_regression_table(model_02)

```

**estimate_means()**

```{r}
#| label: mod02-2

p_inc <- estimate_means(
  model_02,
  by = c("marital", "educ = c(12:20)"),
  estimate = "population")

p_inc
```

```{r}
#| label: mod02-3

p_inc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = educ, y = Mean, colour = marital, shape = marital)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Annual Income",
    subtitle = "by years of education and marital status",
    caption = "Adjusted for age, work hours, and gender") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

```

**`estimate_slopes()`**

```{r}
#| label: mod02-5

estimate_slopes(
  model_02,
  trend = "educ",
  by = "marital"
)
```

## Categorical X Categorical

Without an interaction:

```{r}
#| label: mod03-01

model_03 <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ sex + marital
               + age + hrs1 + educ, data = my_data)

moderndive::get_regression_table(model_03) 

```

With an interaction:

```{r}
#| label: mod03-02

model_03 <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ sex * marital
               + age + hrs1 + educ, data = my_data)

moderndive::get_regression_table(model_03) 

```

**`estimate_means()`**

```{r}
#| label: mod03-07

p_inc  <- estimate_means(
  model_03,
  by = c("marital", "sex"),
  estimate = "population")

p_inc
```
```{r}
#| label: mod03-08

p_inc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = Mean, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~marital) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Annual Income",
    subtitle = "by gender and marital status",
    caption = "Adjusted for age, work hours, and education") +
  theme_minimal(18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none")

```

**`estimate_contrasts()`**


```{r}
#| label: mod03-09

estimate_contrasts(
  model_03,
  contrast = "sex",
  by = "marital",
  estimate = "population")
```

## Continuous X Continuous

Without an interaction:

```{r}
#| label: mod04-01

model_04 <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ age + educ + hrs1 + sex + marital, data = my_data)

moderndive::get_regression_table(model_04) 
```

With an interaction:

```{r}
#| label: mod04-02

model_04 <- lm(formula = realrinc ~ age * educ + hrs1 + sex + marital, data = my_data)

moderndive::get_regression_table(model_04) 

```


**`estimate_means()`** 
```{r}
#| label: mod04-03

# age at selected values of educ
p_inc <- estimate_means(
  model_04,
  by = c(
    "educ = c(12, 14, 16)",
    "age = c(22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44)"  ),
  estimate = "population"
)

p_inc |> 
  head(10)

```

```{r}
#| label: mod04-04

p_inc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = Mean, colour = factor(educ), shape = factor(educ))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Annual Income",
    subtitle = "by age and years of education",
    caption = "Adjusted for work hours, marital status, and gender") +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

```
